verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird documents a free German Term Sheet Generator. It walks users through an interactive questionnaire to produce a simplified term sheet for early financing rounds, which covers the term-sheet part of the story. The SCC generator is also free but is a data-transfer tool, not a startup form, and the EMI factsheets and TwoVenture hub are guidance rather than templates. missing for 10: incorporation document generators or forms, SAFE templates, NDA generators, coverage beyond Germany, explicit confirmation that non-clients can access the tool, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the firm's free public document generators or downloadable startup forms — incorporation documents, SAFEs/term sheets, NDAs — without being a client

citations.quote: Our Term Sheet Generator Tool uses legal document automation software Contract Express to automate the production of a simplified Term Sheet for early financing rounds in Germany.
The Term Sheet Generator Tool is free to use
uses an interactive questionnaire to take organisations step-by-step through the process of producing a Term Sheet
